compression: Each complete shared raw bufferView is compressed independently. Index views use exact-sequence Meshopt INDICES codec, preserving every accessor byteOffset and concatenated byte span. Attribute views use lossless ATTRIBUTES codec. No quantization, tolerance welding, triangle rotation, lossy filter, height shift or geometry simplification.
sourceJoinSampling: Every actual new boundary vertex and 2.5 m intervals; greatest unchanged visible ground across all retained categories.
